verdict.summary: The tag-push cadence guard is correctly placed in the shared setup dependency, uses a full-history checkout, passes the resolved tag through an environment variable, excludes only the tag being cut, suppresses the pre-existing already-tagged no-op path, and still consults crates.io. The structural and real-repository tests exercise the discriminating refusal/allow cases, malformed-tag fail-closed behavior, registry fallback, workflow dependency coverage, and the release caveat. The ZK/MPC release language is appropriately negative and explicitly preserves the pending external-audit and semi-honest-only limitations.
